title: Genetic Diversity of Chinese Giant Salamanders Under the Context of Translocation Using Novel Development of Genomic SSR Markers.

groupReadScopes.sourceConcept: Chinese giant salamanders from six Zhangjiajie sites; sampled individuals not resolved one-to-one to contemporary accepted Andrias species
groupReadScopes.readScope: Raw XML sample collection, DNA/assembly, SSR validation, diversity methods, assembly/SSR results, genetic diversity/structure results and both discussion subsections read; no independent original genotype/assembly/family reanalysis
